rv.q: Staunton, by contrast, is an unbridled joy, brimful of pep and invention. It's hard to remember, post-Vera Drake, that this wonderful Oscar-nominated actress actually made her name in musical theatre but this performance offers a top-class reminder.
The performances of Michael Ball as the avenging demon barber and Imelda Staunton as a bustling, bravura, pie-eyed Mrs Lovett will remain definitive for a very long time.
